description: Git-backed sync for this workspace. Glyph ships with its own libgit2 build — no system <kbd>git</kbd> needed. Single-file tabs sync as part of whichever folder they live in.
notRepo: This folder isn't a git repository yet.

prompt.label: Prompt me
prompt.description: Stop on conflicts and open the resolver.

preferRemote.label: Take remote
preferRemote.description: Discard local edits when they clash.

preferLocal.label: Keep local
preferLocal.description: Push local edits over the remote.

token.label: Personal access token
token.note: Stored in your OS keychain, scoped to this workspace.

error.notConfigured: This workspace isn't configured for sync yet.
error.conflict: Resolve conflicts in {{count}} file(s) before syncing again.
error.invalidState: Repository is in an unexpected state.
error.invalidStateDetail: Repository is in an unexpected state: {{message}}
error.invalidRemoteUrl: Remote URL must start with https:// or ssh:// (or use user@host:path). Put access tokens in the token field, not in the URL.
error.busy: A sync is already running. Try again when it finishes.

settingsRepo.description: Keep your Glyph setup in a git repository of its own and use it on every machine you connect: settings, hotkeys, and the plugins you installed. API keys, recent files, plugin permissions, and error reporting consent stay on each machine.
settingsRepo.tokenNote: Stored in your OS keychain, for the settings repository only.

choice.title: This repository already holds a Glyph setup
choice.message: Pick which setup this machine starts from. Nothing changes until you pick.
choice.useSyncedHint: Use the synced setup: replaces this machine's settings. Plugins only on this machine stay and join the synced setup.
choice.replaceSyncedHint: Replace it with this machine's: the repository keeps its history, and the synced setup becomes this machine's.

conflicts.title: Changed on both machines
conflicts.message: Pick which version of each file to keep, then resolve. Nothing syncs until you do.

plugins.title: Plugins from your synced setup
plugins.toEnable: Turned on in your synced setup

reason.local: Version {{version}}, installed from a folder on another machine
reason.unlisted: Version {{version}}, no longer among the available plugins

skipped.title: Left out of the last sync:

reason.duplicateName: the same name in another letter case
reason.tooMany: more plugin files than Glyph reads
